name: Maya and Friends
source:
An ordinary girl forgot to close the door to her apartment. Whom she met after that  changed her whole life. For the worse. Much worse.

Witness the transformation of Maya from oridinary school girl into a international drug cartel boss in this  densely illustrated (over 100 CGs) and fully narrated by a voice actress visual novel!

[From [url=https://diathorn.itch.io/maya-and-friends]Itch.io[/url]]
